builds.name: Reference: Critical duel
builds.goal: Reference for Yone: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee attack skirmisher who builds a knock-up through Q, takes temporary spirit-form trades and returns after amplifying his attack and ability damage. Record Q knockup readiness and E spirit damage replay. Do not apply replay twice or treat E as a free permanent position; attack-speed/Q limits still matter. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Yone: Record Q knockup readiness and E spirit damage replay. Do not apply replay twice or treat E as a free permanent position; attack-speed/Q limits still matter.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Flow. Do not treat mana regeneration as Flow recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

kitEvidence.formula:
Yone thrusts forward, dealing [25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage.

On hit, grants a stack for [6] seconds. At 2 stacks, this ability causes Yone to dash forward with a wave of wind that Knocks Up for [0.75] seconds and deals [25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage.

Yone strikes all enemies along a path for [(200 / 400 / 600 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.5)] physical damage and [(200 / 400 / 600 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.5)] magic damage, teleporting behind the last champion hit and Knocking Up victims towards Yone.

Yone enters a spirit form for [5] seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining [10]% to [30]% ramping Move Speed. 

When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats [(0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3 / 0.325 / 0.35) × 100]% of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form.

Recast: End spirit form early.

Yone cleaves forward, dealing [(10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50) × 0.5] + [(0.08 / 0.09 / 0.1 / 0.11 / 0.12) × 50]% max Health physical damage and [(10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50) × 0.5] + [(0.08 / 0.09 / 0.1 / 0.11 / 0.12) × 50]% max Health magic damage.

If Yone hits, he gains [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 90; raw flags preserved) + (0.65) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [1.5] seconds. The amount of Shield increases for each champion struck.

Steel and Spirit: Yone uses two blades, causing every second Attack to deal [50]% magic damage.

Intent: Yone's Critical Strike Chance is increased by [100]% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to [(1) × Stat(9)]. Gain @YoneCritToAD*.01@ Bonus AD for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.
